title: THC Post-Harvest Quality Assurance Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied capability in drying and storage quality control, lot scope, excursion investigation, traceability, environmental evidence, records, and controlled product-protection escalation.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
It does not authorize laboratory release, regulatory disposition, destruction, remediation, or recall decisions beyond workplace authorization and applicable law.
